headline: Executive order adds new steps to the existing U.S. ban on importing rough diamonds from Sierra Leone.
what_it_does: This order builds on an earlier U.S. ban on bringing rough, uncut diamonds from Sierra Leone into the country. Based on its title, it adds more measures to that ban. No summary was provided, so the exact new rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and people who import diamonds into the United States
who_it_affects.how: They face added limits on bringing in rough diamonds linked to Sierra Leone.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the available material; the order was signed May 22, 2001.
